title: Welcome
homepage-description: Hi. I am Federico Mattucci, a student of Computer Science at the University of Pisa. With this site I want to tell you a little bit about myself.
self-description: I’m Federico, a Computer Science student at the University of Pisa with a background as an IT technician. Passionate about technology, photography and cooking. I enjoy exploring new challenges in software development and performance optimization. I have work experience through internships and hold an IELTS certification (6.5). My goal is to enrich my journey with an international work experience and prepare myself to study at MIT.
hobbies-description: In my free time I like to do sports, photography, travel and cook.
hobby-description-technologies: I love exploring the latest innovations and developing creative digital solutions. Technology fascinates me because it transforms ideas into reality, improving our daily lives in unexpected ways.
hobby-description-photography: I like to capture special moments and share my photos with others. I became passionate about photography in a completely unexpected way; Photos inspire me beauty and simplicity.
hobby-description-travel: I like to travel and discover new cultures and mentalities. I have been to the USA (2 times), England, Scotland, Ireland, France, Spain, Austria, Germany, Czech Republic, Hungary, Switzerland, as well as many places in Italy. I love my land of Lucca.
hobby-description-cooking: Cooking gives me a sense of free expressiveness and allows me to make mistakes and experiment with new recipes to improve myself
hobby-description-sports: Sport allows me to unload and relax; moreover, I like to challenge myself and take care of my body.
